title: Hearty Uruguayan Chicken Skewers
description: Savory Uruguayan dish featuring chicken legs, tandoor, and cheese pull, perfect for a gluten-free friendly dinner
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, black pepper, and tandoor spice blend
Add the chicken legs to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade
Thread the marinated chicken legs onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the skewers for 20 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through
While the chicken is cooking, melt the provolone cheese in a saucepan over low heat
Once the chicken is done, brush the melted cheese onto the skewers
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro
